cache_contract.allowed_urls: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/owner/repository/<40 hex revision>/path; no query, fragment, port, userinfo, dot/empty components, percent escapes or controls
cache_contract.response_admission: HTTP200, same final URL, no Content-Range, valid declared length when present, completed bounded read
cache_contract.read_bound: caller max_bytes plus fixed header plus one byte; oversize existing entries fail before read

cache_contract.concurrent_staging: Retained; all existing targets are preserved and reread strictly, including empty/malformed entries; identical complete responses accepted, differing or incomplete responses rejected.
cache_contract.platform: Linux only; absent no-replace publication capability fails with no fallback.
